item.title: Mamdani Getting Nervous As Trump Keeps Assassinating Muslim Dictators
item.description: NEW YORK, NY — After U.S. military action against the Ayatollah, New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani was reportedly getting nervous that President Donald Trump keeps assassinating Muslim dictators.

item.title: Obama Confused To See Bombs Falling On Iran Instead Of Pallets Of Cash
item.description: WASHINGTON, D.C. — With military operations ongoing against the Ayatollah's Islamic regime, former President Barack Obama expressed confusion at seeing bombs falling on Iran instead of pallets stacked with U.S. cash.

item.title: Man Goes Back In Time To Mesmerize Ancients With Futuristic Technology Of Gushers
item.description: EGYPT — Newly unearthed records appear to indicate a man claiming to be from the future traveled to ancient Memphis to wow the early Egyptians with the futuristic technology of Gushers.

item.description: Fox News: Trump Strikes Iran In 'Perfectly Executed' Military Operation

item.title: Man Awarded Medal Of Honor For Courageously Monitoring Iran War Effort Online
item.description: WASHINGTON, D.C. — In a modest ceremony at the White House, President Trump awarded the Medal of Honor to a man who was up all weekend monitoring the situation in Iran from his home computer, the administration confirmed on Monday.

item.title: 'Soon...,' Whispers Dad To Dormant Lawnmower In Garage
item.description: LEE'S SUMMIT, MO — The dreams of spring were in the air during last weekend, as one local suburban dad gently consoled himself next to his dormant lawnmower in the garage.
